wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext |prevcode=PG14 |prevtitle=The Frozen World |nextcode=PG16 |nexttitle=The Beauty Eternal |series=Pokémon Generations |colorscheme=Hoso}} {{EpisodeInfobox |epcode=PG15 |colorscheme=Hoso |title_en=The King Returns |title_ja=帰還 |title_ja_trans=The Return |release_method=Web release |screen=hd |broadcast_jp=January 27, 2017 |broadcast_us=December 2, 2016 |en_op=N/A |ja_op=N/A |ja_ed=N/A |olmteam=Team Kato |scenario=冨岡淳広 |storyboard=高橋知也 |director=高橋知也 |art=松浦有紗 |morecredits=no |epstaffpage=PG11-PG18 |footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7F4PiWYc1Rw The King Returns]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|220215|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The King Returns''' (Japanese: '''帰還''' ''The Return'') is the fifteenth episode of [[Pokémon Generations]]. It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 2, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on January 26, 2017. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== His plans left in ruins, Ghetsis makes one last attempt to bring Unova under his icy grasp. A hero arrives, intending to stop him. ==Plot== In the frozen depths of [[Giant Chasm]], [[Ghetsis]] orders {{p|Kyurem}} to continue spreading its ice over [[Unova]] and freeze the [[region]] completely. As Kyurem releases another {{m|Blizzard|wave of ice}}, a {{m|Fusion Flare}} appears to intercept it. Ghetsis notes the presence of [[N]] and {{p|Reshiram}}, who have come to stop his plans. Ghetsis addresses N as "the freak without a human heart", while N expresses his desire to stop Kyurem's further suffering, and his wish to protect the region of Unova, in which he learned how to live as a human. Ghetsis remarks that N's speech proves that his training to be king wasn't a complete waste, but nonetheless notes N's roles in ruining his plans for world domination, and activates the [[DNA Splicers]]. Under its power, Kyurem releases a series of energy restraints from its icy spikes, eventually trapping Reshiram despite its best attempts to evade them, reverting the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{t|Dragon}} into its form as the [[Light Stone]]. Kyurem proceeds to absorbs the Light Stone inside itself, transforming into {{form|Kyurem|White Kyurem}}. N expresses his disbelief that Pokémon have the ability to {{pkmn|fusion|fuse}}. Ghetsis berates N for choosing to abandon his path to kinghood, forcing Ghetsis to take over Unova by force, and orders White Kyurem to freeze N solid. Feeling Reshiram's voice from inside White Kyurem, N confirms that Reshiram can still be separated. Unhinged, Ghetsis angrily claims that people and Pokémon are mere tools for him to achieve his goals. Despite his misgivings, N addresses Ghetsis as his father, telling him that people and Pokémon can achieve stronger ideals and dreams by collaborating. Ghetsis demands for N to keep quiet, addressing him again as a freak since "no real person could talk to a Pokémon". Just as White Kyurem unleashes its {{m|Ice Burn}} attack, a {{m|Thunderbolt}} intercepts it before it can hit its target. N turns around and sees that {{p|Zekrom}} and {{ga|Hilbert}} have arrived to help, and Ghetsis grimaces. The episode ends as both Legendary Dragon-type Pokémon stare each other down, ready for the confrontation. ==Major events== * [[N]] arrives at the [[Giant Chasm]] to confront [[Ghetsis]]. * Ghetsis uses the [[DNA Splicers]] to {{pkmn|fusion|fuse}} N's {{p|Reshiram}} with {{p|Kyurem}}, creating the {{form|Kyurem|White Kyurem}}. * {{ga|Hilbert}} arrives with {{p|Zekrom}} to help N. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{ga|Hilbert}} * [[Ghetsis]] * [[N]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Zekrom}} ({{ga|Hilbert}}'s) * {{p|Reshiram}} ([[N]]'s; fused with Kyurem) * {{p|Kyurem}} ({{form|Kyurem|Normal and White Kyurem}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FDBB99|bordercolor=FD7F4F |nl={{tt|De koning keert terug|The king returns}} |fr_eu={{tt|L’arrivée du roi|The arrival of the king}} |de={{tt|Der König kehrt zurück|The king returns}} |it={{tt|Il ritorno del sovrano|The return of the king}} |ko={{tt|왕의 귀환|The Return of the King}} |pt_br={{tt|O Retorno do Rei|The Return of the King}} |es_eu={{tt|El regreso del rey|The return of the king}} }} {{-}} {{EpicodePrevNext |prevcode=PG14 |prevtitle=The Frozen World |nextcode=PG16 |nexttitle=The Beauty Eternal |series=Pokémon Generations |colorscheme=Hoso}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Pokémon Generations episodes|15]] [[Category:Episodes written by Atsuhiro Tomioka]] [[Category:Episodes storyboarded and directed by Tomoya Takahashi]] [[Category:Episodes storyboarded by Tomoya Takahashi]] [[Category:Episodes directed by Tomoya Takahashi]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time animation directors]] [[Category:Episodes which aired in the United States before Japan]] [[de:Pokémon Generationen Folge 15: Der König kehrt zurück]] [[es:GEN15]] [[fr:PG15]] [[it:PG15]] [[ja:PG第15話]] [[zh:宝可梦世代 第15集]]
